items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked disclosure sections with smooth auto-height animation, a springy chevron and full arrow/Home/End keyboard support.

items.name: after-cursor
items.title: After Cursor
items.description: Translucent, drifting echoes of the cursor trail behind the pointer like afterimages.

items.name: afterimage-type
items.title: Afterimage Type
items.description: A headline trailed by fading echo copies that lag behind it, drifting on a loop or chasing the pointer.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Confirmation modal on the native <dialog> with a springy scale-in, focus starting on Cancel, async confirm with spinner and destructive styling.

items.name: animated-button
items.title: Animated Button
items.description: On hover a slanted fill sweeps across while the label slides out and an arrow slides in.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated Tabs
items.description: Tab bar with a springy shared-layout indicator and panels that slide and blur in the direction of travel.

items.name: animated-testimonials
items.title: Animated Testimonials
items.description: A stack of tilted photo cards that shuffles to the active person while their quote blurs in word by word.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement
items.description: Pill-shaped news link with a highlighted tag, a periodic shine sweep and a chevron that extends into an arrow on hover.

items.name: arc-frame
items.title: Arc Frame
items.description: Wraps any element in crackling, glowing arcs of electricity that crawl around its edge.

items.name: arc-marquee
items.title: Arc Marquee
items.description: An endless marquee flowing along a curved path. Grab it to scrub, and flick to send it the other way.

items.name: arc-sidebar
items.title: Arc Sidebar
items.description: A sectioned nav whose active marker arcs between rows, shoves the label aside on landing and crossfades into each section's ink. Works as a static rail or a drawer.

items.name: ascii-text
items.title: ASCII Text
items.description: Text rasterized into shimmering ASCII glyphs on a canvas, rippling in a slow wave and bulging under the pointer like a lens.

items.name: ask-box
items.title: Ask Box
items.description: AI prompt input that grows with your text, holds springy attachment chips, and morphs its send arrow into a stop button ringed by a spinner while generating.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Box locked to a width/height ratio, with a shimmer placeholder that dissolves into the image once it loads.

items.name: aurora-dots
items.title: Aurora Dots
items.description: A dot matrix lit by drifting aurora ribbons; each dot takes its color from the moving light field and glows near the cursor. WebGL.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Profile picture that fades in once loaded, falls back to colorful initials, and shows an optional presence dot.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Overlapping avatar stack that fans apart on hover, with name tooltips and a +N overflow chip.

items.name: background-paths
items.title: Background Paths
items.description: Two layered ribbons of flowing SVG curves with light running along their strokes. Pure SVG + CSS.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact status label in six variants with an optional live dot, pulse ring and a glinting shine sweep.

items.name: badge-strap
items.title: Badge Strap
items.description: An ID badge hanging from a woven strap with verlet rope physics. Grab it, fling it and watch it swing back.

items.name: bars-wave
items.title: Bars Wave
items.description: A row of glowing equalizer bars whose heights roll across the screen as a layered wave. Canvas 2D.

items.name: bayer-waves
items.title: Bayer Waves
items.description: Flowing waves rendered with 8x8 ordered Bayer dithering in two colors; the cursor sends ripples through them. WebGL.

items.name: bead-bin
items.title: Bead Bin
items.description: Glossy colored balls tumble in with gravity, collide and pile up; sweep the cursor through to shove them around. Canvas 2D.

items.name: bead-tray
items.title: Bead Tray
items.description: A segmented tray where the active item pulls out on a liquid metaball thread and drops a bead when it snaps.

items.name: beam-pour
items.title: Beam Pour
items.description: A glowing laser beam pours down into a misty splash, with volumetric haze, flicker and drifting motes. Raw WebGL.

items.name: beam-splitter
items.title: Beam Splitter
items.description: A slowly rotating glass prism splitting a white beam into a shimmering rainbow fan. Aim the beam with the cursor. WebGL.

items.name: beams-upstream
items.title: Beams Upstream
items.description: Thin light beams rise along the vertical lines of a softly masked grid, trailing a glowing tail. Canvas 2D.

items.name: bend-ribbon
items.title: Bend Ribbon
items.description: An endless ribbon of images bent along an arc that you scroll, drag or arrow through, easing to a snap.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: Responsive bento layout of feature tiles with hover lifts, playful icons and a cursor spotlight that glows across tile borders.

items.name: bit-flurry
items.title: Bit Flurry
items.description: Chunky pixel-art snowflakes drifting down in parallax layers, swaying in the wind. WebGL.

items.name: bitmask-veil
items.title: Bitmask Veil
items.description: A flowing 1-bit ordered-dither veil that dissolves around the cursor to reveal what is underneath.

items.name: bleed-reveal
items.title: Bleed Reveal
items.description: A media card that grows from an inset, rounded frame to full-bleed as you scroll, splitting its headline apart.

items.name: blind-light
items.title: Blind Light
items.description: Warm light slanting in from one side through window blinds, with dust motes glinting in the beams. WebGL.

items.name: blob-lamp
items.title: Blob Lamp
items.description: Glossy liquid blobs that drift, merge and split, with one that follows your cursor. Raw WebGL.

items.name: block-dissolve
items.title: Block Dissolve
items.description: On hover or focus, an image dissolves into a second one through a wave of pixel blocks spreading from the pointer.

items.name: bob-shapes
items.title: Bob Shapes
items.description: Rows of small circles, squares and triangles bobbing and turning in rolling waves; they swell near the cursor. WebGL.

items.name: bolt-strike
items.title: Bolt Strike
items.description: A night storm where procedural, forking lightning bolts strike at random spots and light up the clouds. Canvas 2D.

items.name: bracket-focus
items.title: Bracket Focus
items.description: One word at a time snaps into focus inside gliding corner brackets while the rest of the sentence blurs.

items.name: brick-gallery
items.title: Brick Gallery
items.description: Animated masonry image grid: tiles fly in with a staggered blur-to-focus, glide to new slots on resize and zoom on hover.

items.name: burn-button
items.title: Burn Button
items.description: Hold to light a spark that burns along the border; if it makes it all the way round, it bursts. Works with Space and Enter.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: shadcn-style button with six variants, a tactile press, icon slots and a loading spinner that slides the label aside.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Dependency-free date picker grid with single or range selection, springy month slides, range preview on hover and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Composable card surface (header, title, description, content, footer) with an optional hover lift and a rotating gradient border.

items.name: card-flip
items.title: Card Flip
items.description: A 3D card that springs over to reveal its back on hover or click, with Enter/Space to toggle.

items.name: cascade-list
items.title: Cascade List
items.description: Items drop in one at a time, like a live notification feed.

items.name: charge-band
items.title: Charge Band
items.description: A glowing horizontal band of plasma wrapped in flickering electric filaments; it bends toward the cursor. WebGL.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Native checkbox restyled with a hand-drawn tick animation, indeterminate dash, label and description.

items.name: checklist-cell
items.title: Checklist Cell
items.description: A checklist card whose ticks draw in, labels strike through, finished items glide to the bottom and a progress ring fills toward a celebratory check.

items.name: chrome-pour
items.title: Chrome Pour
items.description: Liquid chrome flows inside a beveled star, heart, ring or glyph, with reflections that lean toward the cursor. Raw WebGL.

items.name: cipher-reveal
items.title: Cipher Reveal
items.description: Scrambled glyphs resolve into the real text, on view or on hover.

items.name: clock
items.title: Clock
items.description: An elegant analog clock with a smooth sweeping (or bouncy ticking) second hand, minute ticks, a digital readout and any IANA time zone.

items.name: cloth-wire
items.title: Cloth Wire
items.description: A wireframe mesh that stretches around the cursor like cloth and springs back; click to send a shockwave.

items.name: cobweb
items.title: Cobweb
items.description: A spider web of silk threads swaying in a breeze; the cursor stretches them and they ripple as they spring back.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code display with a filename tab, line numbers, highlighted lines that sweep in, lightweight built-in token coloring and a copy button that springs into a check.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Show-more region whose height, opacity and blur ease open smoothly, controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: column-drift
items.title: Column Drift
items.description: A tilted wall of image columns drifting up and down at different speeds, pausing on hover.

items.name: column-lines
items.title: Column Lines
items.description: Evenly spaced column lines with colored light pulses falling down them at random. Canvas 2D.

items.name: contour-map
items.title: Contour Map
items.description: Animated topographic contour lines over slowly shifting terrain, with a hill that rises under the cursor. WebGL.

items.name: cosmic-background
items.title: Cosmic Background
items.description: Deep-space nebula clouds with parallax star layers, twinkling flares and the odd shooting star. WebGL.

items.name: crease-type
items.title: Crease Type
items.description: Lines or letters swing open like creased paper in 3D, with a soft shadow lifting as each piece unfolds.

items.name: crt-warp
items.title: CRT Warp
items.description: A glowing gradient seen through an old CRT: barrel curvature, scanlines, RGB mask, flicker and a rolling bar. WebGL.

items.name: crumple-delete
items.title: Crumple Delete
items.description: Deleting a note scrunches it into a paper ball that arcs into a bin, whose lid flips open and wobbles shut. Undo tosses it back out and smooths it flat.

items.name: current-trace
items.title: Current Trace
items.description: Pulses of glowing current race along any SVG outline, flickering and arcing as they go.

items.name: cursor-highlight
items.title: Cursor Highlight
items.description: A soft glow follows the cursor and springs into a pill that wraps whatever link or card you hover.

items.name: deck-cycle
items.title: Deck Cycle
items.description: A skewed 3D stack of cards that cycles on its own: the front card drops away and springs back in behind the others.

items.name: decorated-text
items.title: Decorated Text
items.description: Frames a word with corner brackets, a dashed selection box and twinkling sparkles that draw in on view or hover.

items.name: departure-board
items.title: Departure Board
items.description: An airport departures board: every tile flips through the drum until it lands on the next word.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal built on the native <dialog>: blurred backdrop, spring scale-in and fade-out, Escape to close and focus returned to the trigger.

items.name: dot-terrain
items.title: Dot Terrain
items.description: A perspective field of glowing dots rolling toward you in terrain-like waves; the camera leans with the cursor. WebGL.

items.name: dot-wave
items.title: Dot Wave
items.description: A perspective field of dots rolling in layered sine waves, fading into the horizon. Canvas 2D.

items.name: draggable-avatar
items.title: Draggable Avatar
items.description: An avatar you can drag and fling around its container; it springs to the nearest corner with the throw's momentum.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Bottom sheet on the native <dialog> that springs up, drags with a rubber-band feel, snaps to heights, and flicks down to dismiss while the backdrop fades with it.

items.name: drift-card
items.title: Drift Card
items.description: A card whose photo, text and chips drift at different parallax depths as the pointer moves, with a soft tilt and glare.

items.name: drip-range
items.title: Drip Range
items.description: Range slider whose thumb stretches with drag speed and drips a gooey value bubble while you slide.

items.name: droop-field
items.title: Droop Field
items.description: A text field whose words and underline droop along an arc while idle, then spring flat the moment you focus it.

items.name: drop-nav
items.title: Drop Nav
items.description: A compact navbar that springs open downward into a row of colorful link cards.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu button on the native Popover API with a highlight that glides between items, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items, submenus, typeahead and full keyboard support.

items.name: droplet-tabs
items.title: Droplet Tabs
items.description: A segmented control whose highlight stretches like a drop of liquid as it glides to the new option, then snaps tight. Arrow keys move it.

items.name: drum-picker
items.title: Drum Picker
items.description: iOS-style picker wheel: rows curve around a 3D cylinder, snap into place and respond to wheel, drag, touch and arrow keys.

items.name: dual-sparks
items.title: Dual Sparks
items.description: Two streams of sparks rush in from opposite edges and burst against each other in a glowing core. Canvas 2D.

items.name: duration-picker
items.title: Duration Picker
items.description: Hours, minutes and a save button fused into one bar that pulls apart on a liquid thread while you edit.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A squircle pill that eases into a slab when tapped, swaps its content on the way, and glows red on alert.

items.name: edge-fog
items.title: Edge Fog
items.description: A progressive edge blur built from stacked, masked backdrop-filter layers. Drop it over any scrolling area.

items.name: electric-text
items.title: Electric Text
items.description: Text wrapped in a crackling electric outline, driven by animated SVG turbulence displacement.

items.name: ellipse-photos
items.title: Ellipse Photos
items.description: Photos circle a tilted ellipse in pseudo-3D, scaling and dimming with depth, and glide to a stop on hover.

items.name: ember-cells
items.title: Ember Cells
items.description: A grid of cells that light up under the cursor and cool into a fading color trail.

items.name: ember-path
items.title: Ember Path
items.description: Grid pixels ignite along the cursor path, burn white-hot and shrink away as they fade.

items.name: enter-view
items.title: Enter View
items.description: Slides, scales and fades its children into place when they scroll into view.

items.name: expandable-cards
items.title: Expandable Cards
items.description: A list of cards where the one you pick morphs into a detail view with a shared-layout spring, closing on Escape or backdrop click.

items.name: expandable-dock
items.title: Expandable Dock
items.description: A compact pill of actions that springs open into a panel (search, quick actions, inbox, player), morphing its size and corners between states.

items.name: extrude-type
items.title: Extrude Type
items.description: Chunky extruded 3D lettering built from stacked layers that tilts toward the pointer and sways gently when idle.

items.name: facescape
items.title: Facescape
items.description: A little face built from simple shapes that watches your cursor, lifts its brows and grins as you get close. Click to boop.

items.name: fancy-text
items.title: Fancy Text
items.description: Outlined letters that lift and fill with a sweeping gradient, one after another, on hover.

items.name: feature-showcase
items.title: Feature Showcase
items.description: Feature list with an expanding description and a filling progress bar that auto-advances, crossfading a matching visual on the side.

items.name: file-lift
items.title: File Lift
items.description: A folder whose flap tips open on hover or focus so its files float up and fan out, then settle back in; click pins it open.

items.name: file-pocket
items.title: File Pocket
items.description: A folder that springs open on hover or click, fanning out the paper cards tucked inside.

items.name: filings
items.title: Filings
items.description: A field of short lines that swing to point at the cursor like iron filings, glowing and stretching as it nears.

items.name: film-grain
items.title: Film Grain
items.description: An animated film-grain overlay. Pre-baked canvas frames, so it costs almost nothing to run.

items.name: fizz-menu
items.title: Fizz Menu
items.description: A pill navbar whose toggle bursts into a cloud of springy bubble links that pop in one after another.

items.name: flashy-card
items.title: Flashy Card
items.description: A card with a comet of gradient light sweeping its border that brightens, blooms into a glow and flashes across the surface on hover.

items.name: flex-navbar
items.title: Flex Navbar
items.description: Icon navbar whose items spring open to reveal a tinted label on hover or focus while their neighbours flex aside.

items.name: fling-confirm
items.title: Fling Confirm
items.description: Slide-to-confirm track: the knob stretches as you fling it, commits past the threshold with a popping check, and springs home with a wobble if you let go early.

items.name: fling-toast
items.title: Fling Toast
items.description: Stacked toasts that fan out on hover, pause their progress timers while you read, and fling away when swiped sideways.

items.name: flip-flow
items.title: Flip Flow
items.description: Split-flap tiles that flip through their items like a flip clock, the top half falling over a hinge; stagger several to make a flipping stream.

items.name: flip-stack
items.title: Flip Stack
items.description: A pile of cards where clicking tosses the top card up, flips it end over end and drops it behind the pile as the rest step forward.

items.name: flock-trail
items.title: Flock Trail
items.description: A flock of boids that separates, aligns and swirls around the cursor, leaving luminous trails.

items.name: flood-pills
items.title: Flood Pills
items.description: Pill navigation whose items flood with a rising circle of color on hover, with a sliding active dot and a compact menu on narrow containers.

items.name: focus-outline
items.title: Focus Outline
items.description: A soft, glowing outline that snaps into razor focus wherever the cursor comes near. WebGL signed distance fields.

items.name: focus-pull
items.title: Focus Pull
items.description: Fades and un-blurs its children as they scroll into view, like a lens pulling focus.

items.name: fog-deck
items.title: Fog Deck
items.description: A looping carousel where cards recede into 3D depth and blur the further they sit from center. Drag, click, arrows or keys.

items.name: foil-sweep
items.title: Foil Sweep
items.description: A glossy band of light sweeps across the card on hover or focus, like light catching foil.

items.name: folder-tree
items.title: Folder Tree
items.description: File explorer tree with springy expand/collapse, a highlight that glides to the selected row, file-type icons and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: follow-cursor
items.title: Follow Cursor
items.description: A pill label that trails the cursor across a card on a spring, leans into motion and squishes on click.

items.name: fork-flash
items.title: Fork Flash
items.description: A crackling procedural lightning bolt with forking branches, strobing strikes and storm clouds lit from within. WebGL.

items.name: frost-tiles
items.title: Frost Tiles
items.description: Icon tiles with a colored backplate behind a frosted glass front that lifts and tilts toward the pointer on hover.

items.name: github-activity
items.title: GitHub Activity
items.description: A contribution calendar on a squircle card whose busiest repos stack as avatars and expand into a drawer over the grid.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: Frosted glassmorphism card with a refractive edge light, film grain and a pointer-follow sheen.

items.name: glass-drift
items.title: Glass Drift
items.description: Translucent glass shards drift in layers over soft glowing color, bending the light with refraction, dispersion and slow cursor parallax. WebGL.

items.name: glint-bot
items.title: Glint Bot
items.description: A retro robot with a lit CSS-3D visor head that turns toward your cursor, spinning reel eyes and jointed arms. It blinks, smiles when booped, blushes when petted and gets dizzy if you poke it too much.

items.name: globe
items.title: Globe
items.description: A rotating dotted globe drawn on canvas, with pulsing city markers, great-circle arcs carrying travelling light, drag-to-spin inertia and a soft atmosphere.

items.name: globe-menu
items.title: Globe Menu
items.description: Menu items wrapped around a sphere you drag to spin; it settles on the disc facing you and reveals its title.

items.name: globe-wireframe
items.title: Globe Wireframe
items.description: A rotating wireframe globe of latitude and longitude lines with depth-faded hidden lines and a glowing scan that sweeps pole to pole or across the face. Drag to spin.

items.name: gloss-pill
items.title: Gloss Pill
items.description: A glossy glass pill with a specular hotspot and rim light that glide after the pointer.

items.name: glow-border
items.title: Glow Border
items.description: A comet of light orbits the element's border.

items.name: glow-eddies
items.title: Glow Eddies
items.description: Luminous, colorful ether that flows on its own and swirls into eddies wherever the cursor moves. WebGL.

items.name: glow-sphere
items.title: Glow Sphere
items.description: A glowing iridescent orb whose film of color slides around its rim; it wobbles and brightens when hovered. WebGL.

items.name: glyph-hover
items.title: Glyph Hover
items.description: Letters near the cursor dissolve into flickering glyphs and settle back into the original text, strongest right under the pointer.

items.name: glyph-spill
items.title: Glyph Spill
items.description: A trail of glyphs or emoji that spills from the pointer inside its container, spinning and fading as it drifts.

items.name: glyph-storm
items.title: Glyph Storm
items.description: A full grid of monospace glyphs that keep swapping characters and colors, framed by a soft vignette. Canvas 2D.

items.name: god-rays
items.title: God Rays
items.description: Soft god rays streaming from an edge or corner, swaying gently and leaning toward the cursor. WebGL.

items.name: goo-chaser
items.title: Goo Chaser
items.description: A trail of gooey blobs that stretch, merge and split as they chase the pointer.

items.name: goo-radio
items.title: Goo Radio
items.description: A radio group with one gooey dot that stretches as it slides to the new option, splats on landing and jiggles back into shape.

items.name: grain-gradient
items.title: Grain Gradient
items.description: A slowly morphing mesh gradient of four colors under a layer of moving film grain.

items.name: gravity
items.title: Gravity
items.description: Drops any elements into a real physics box where they tumble, stack, and can be grabbed and thrown.

items.name: grid-background
items.title: Grid Background
items.description: A fine grid where random cells softly light up and fade out, framed by a radial fade. Canvas 2D.

items.name: grow-panels
items.title: Grow Panels
items.description: Row of photo panels where the active one flex-grows open while the rest shrink, auto-advancing with a progress bar.

items.name: hairline-coords
items.title: Hairline Coords
items.description: Full-bleed crosshair lines with live coordinates that tear and glitch when you hover a link.

items.name: halo-follow
items.title: Halo Follow
items.description: A soft colored glow trails the cursor inside its container and swells over interactive children.

items.name: halo-rings
items.title: Halo Rings
items.description: Concentric glowing rings spin at their own pace, breathe, and bend toward the cursor.

items.name: haze-shafts
items.title: Haze Shafts
items.description: Soft volumetric light beams slanting across a dark scene, drifting and breathing through noisy haze. WebGL.

items.name: heat-haze
items.title: Heat Haze
items.description: Type that ripples like heat haze through an SVG turbulence filter on hover, with an optional RGB fringe, then eases back to crisp.

items.name: helix-cards
items.title: Helix Cards
items.description: Cards wound around an endless 3D helix that keeps turning, and spins faster when you scroll or drag.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold To Confirm
items.description: Destructive action guard: press and hold until the bar fills. Works with Space and Enter.

items.name: holo-badge
items.title: Holo Badge
items.description: Holographic profile card that tilts toward the pointer while rainbow foil, glitter and glare slide across it, with a glass contact bar.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Rich preview card that blooms out of a link on hover or focus, with open/close delays, an arrow, smart flipping and a top-layer render.

items.name: hover-shelf
items.title: Hover Shelf
items.description: macOS-style toolbar where icons magnify as the cursor passes.

items.name: hud-type
items.title: HUD Type
items.description: HUD-style lettering that flickers on inside bracket frames, with a scan line, live readouts and a blinking caret.

items.name: hue-folds
items.title: Hue Folds
items.description: Smooth ribbons of color that bend, fold and drift; the cursor gently warps them like a lens. WebGL.

items.name: hyperlink
items.title: Hyperlink
items.description: An inline link whose underline draws in from the left and exits to the right, with a springy arrow nudge and a hover or focus preview card for the destination.

items.name: infinite-canvas
items.title: Infinite Canvas
items.description: A bounded moodboard-style canvas on a dotted grid: drag to pan with inertia, scroll or pinch to zoom around the pointer, keyboard friendly.

items.name: ink-fluid
items.title: Ink Fluid
items.description: Real-time fluid ink that swirls off the cursor in shifting colors. A compact WebGL2 stable-fluids solver, scoped to its container.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input with icon slots, three sizes, a focus line that sweeps out from the center and an error state that shakes and slides in its message.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time-code field: slots that pop each digit in, a blinking caret, paste and SMS autofill, a wave on completion and a shake on error.

items.name: interactive-input
items.title: Interactive Input
items.description: A text field with a floating label, a focus ring that blooms out of the border, a spring-in clear button, a character-count ring and a shake on error.

items.name: iphone-mockup
items.title: iPhone Mockup
items.description: A realistic, pure-CSS titanium phone frame with dynamic island, side buttons, status bar and a moving glass glare that tilts toward the pointer. Renders any children or an image as the screen.

items.name: iso-pulse
items.title: Iso Pulse
items.description: A tiny isometric lattice of cubes or dots that pulses in a diagonal wave while the whole grid sways in 3D. Pure CSS.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys drawn as 3D keycaps that physically sink when the matching key is pressed, plus a group for shortcuts.

items.name: keyboard
items.title: Keyboard
items.description: A realistic compact keyboard whose keycaps sink and glow with backlight when you press the matching physical keys or click them, with a live typing strip and caps-lock LED.

items.name: kinetic-testimonials
items.title: Kinetic Testimonials
items.description: Rows of testimonial cards drifting in opposite directions, pausing on hover with soft edge fades.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form label with a required asterisk, optional tag and hint text that lights up while its control has focus.

items.name: lamp-hero
items.title: Lamp Hero
items.description: Hero section lit by a glowing light tube whose cone swings open and the heading rises into the light when it scrolls into view.

items.name: lava-gloss
items.title: Lava Gloss
items.description: Smooth, glossy plasma flowing through a three-color palette; the cursor twists it into a whirlpool. WebGL.

items.name: layer-stack
items.title: Layer Stack
items.description: Translucent design layers stacked in isometric view that fan apart on hover, with a layers panel to spotlight each one.

items.name: layer-swells
items.title: Layer Swells
items.description: Stacked gradient waves rolling at different speeds, each casting a soft shadow on the layer behind.

items.name: layered-button
items.title: Layered Button
items.description: A 3D keycap of stacked offset layers that spread on hover and compress on press.

items.name: layered-text
items.title: Layered Text
items.description: Colored copies hide behind each letter and fan out in a springy cascade on hover, then stack back.

items.name: lean-card
items.title: Lean Card
items.description: A card that leans and drifts toward the pointer while its shadow slides away and the content counter-leans for depth.

items.name: lean-tip
items.title: Lean Tip
items.description: A tooltip that springs out of its trigger with a soft bounce, then drifts and leans after the pointer on a warm glow. Opens on focus, closes on Escape.

items.name: lens-follow
items.title: Lens Follow
items.description: A liquid glass lens that trails the cursor, magnifying and refracting the content beneath it with chromatic edges.

items.name: letter-rise
items.title: Letter Rise
items.description: Reveals text character by character or word by word when it scrolls into view.

items.name: like-pop
items.title: Like Pop
items.description: Like button whose heart squashes, pops and bursts into particles while the count rolls up digit by digit.

items.name: line-roll
items.title: Line Roll
items.description: Lines of text roll endlessly through a soft-masked window, the active line sharp and its neighbours blurred.

items.name: lit-bento
items.title: Lit Bento
items.description: Bento grid whose cards light up with a cursor-following border glow, tilt gently and fill with drifting particles on hover.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Five small, clean loaders in one component: a stretching arc spinner, squashy hopping dots, equalizer bars, a heartbeat pulse and bunching orbit dots.

items.name: lock-on
items.title: Lock On
items.description: A spinning reticle cursor whose corner brackets snap around any element you mark as a target.

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login Form
items.description: A polished sign-in card with social buttons, password reveal, remember me, animated inline validation, a shake on error and a loading-to-success flow.

items.name: logo-stepper
items.title: Logo Stepper
items.description: A row of logos that steps through one at a time, with a spring focus ring sliding between them and a caption per logo.

items.name: luminescent-flows
items.title: Luminescent Flows
items.description: Glowing currents drift like bioluminescent tides, with light pulses traveling along them and specks of plankton. WebGL.

items.name: lustre-text
items.title: Lustre Text
items.description: Polished metal lettering with a bevel and a specular glint that sweeps across, or follows your pointer.

items.name: magma-crust
items.title: Magma Crust
items.description: Slowly drifting plates of dark crust split by white-hot, pulsing cracks of molten metal. WebGL.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Infinite logo loop that eases to a stop on hover, grows the logo under the cursor and fades its edges. Works with any content.

items.name: mask-wipe
items.title: Mask Wipe
items.description: A big heading wiped into view by a feathered mask sweep, with a gradient or photo flowing through the letters.

items.name: matrix-orb
items.title: Matrix Orb
items.description: A liquid metaball orb for voice or AI status: it breathes when idle, ripples when listening and churns off droplets when thinking.

items.name: media-card
items.title: Media Card
items.description: Music player card with cover art, a scrubbable progress bar, a morphing play/pause icon and a live equalizer.

items.name: melt-card
items.title: Melt Card
items.description: An image card that leans toward the cursor and melts into noisy SVG displacement the faster you move.

items.name: memo-pill
items.title: Memo Pill
items.description: A voice-note recorder pill that springs open into live waveform bars and a timer, then collapses the take into a playable, sendable waveform. Input is simulated.

items.name: meteor-orbit
items.title: Meteor Orbit
items.description: Icons circling a center on concentric rings while glowing meteor streaks race along each orbit.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: Shooting stars streak across the container. Pure CSS, SSR-safe.

items.name: mirror-ripple
items.title: Mirror Ripple
items.description: A slowly folding mirror-like chrome surface that ripples wherever the cursor moves or clicks. WebGL.

items.name: model-studio
items.title: Model Studio
items.description: Three.js studio viewer for a procedural model: physical clearcoat material, soft shadows, drag to orbit, auto-rotate and clamped zoom.

items.name: modern-loader
items.title: Modern Loader
items.description: A gradient comet arc orbits with a glowing head while the ring breathes between circle and squircle, around a counter-spinning inner arc and a morphing core.

items.name: mono-spotlight
items.title: Mono Spotlight
items.description: A grid of profile cards drained to grayscale, with a soft spotlight of full color that trails the cursor.

items.name: morning-widget
items.title: Morning Widget
items.description: A squircle card on a drifting sunrise mesh that greets you by name, rolls a live clock digit by digit and rotates motivational lines.

items.name: morph-text
items.title: Morph Text
items.description: Cycles through words that melt into one another through a gooey blur-and-threshold crossfade.

items.name: morphy-button
items.title: Morphy Button
items.description: A pill that morphs into a spinning circle while loading, then pops a drawn check on success.

items.name: mosaic-flip
items.title: Mosaic Flip
items.description: A card that dissolves into a random pixel grid on hover and reassembles as its second face.

items.name: mote-field
items.title: Mote Field
items.description: A drifting constellation that links nearby points and flees the cursor.

items.name: motion-cards
items.title: Motion Cards
items.description: A card grid that springs in with a stagger and, when filtered by tag, shrinks leaving cards away while the rest glide into their new cells.

items.name: motion-grid
items.title: Motion Grid
items.description: A grid of tiles that shrink, spin and flash in rolling waves radiating from whichever tile you click.

items.name: motion-navbar
items.title: Motion Navbar
items.description: Site navbar with a hover pill that glides between links and a single dropdown that morphs its size and position between menus.

items.name: moving-lines
items.title: Moving Lines
items.description: Fine diagonal lines drift sideways while bright comets of light race along them. Canvas 2D.

items.name: navbar-flow
items.title: Navbar Flow
items.description: A full-width navbar that flows into a floating glass pill as you scroll, with a sliding hover highlight, scroll progress line and an animated mobile menu.

items.name: near-bold
items.title: Near Bold
items.description: Letters grow bolder, larger and brighter the closer the pointer gets, with a tunable radius and falloff.

items.name: neon-checker
items.title: Neon Checker
items.description: A grid of rounded squares cycling through acid neon colors in interfering waves; the cursor lights them up. WebGL.

items.name: neon-floor
items.title: Neon Floor
items.description: A neon perspective grid floor swept by a glowing scan line, with a horizon that follows the cursor.

items.name: night-fold
items.title: Night Fold
items.description: A dark, moody veil of slowly folding noise with a soft color tint and film grain. WebGL.

items.name: north-glow
items.title: North Glow
items.description: Slow drifting color blobs, blurred into a northern-lights glow. Pure CSS.

items.name: not-found
items.title: Not Found
items.description: Drop-in 404 section: a huge parallax code with RGB-split glitch bursts, a friendly message and a home button.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: An odometer-style number in a squircle window: every digit is a 0-9 strip that rolls to its new value.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: An odometer-style number where every digit column rolls on a spring, with − / + controls and soft faded edges.

items.name: oil-film
items.title: Oil Film
items.description: An oil-slick film of flowing interference colors that swirls around the cursor.

items.name: orb-button
items.title: Orb Button
items.description: A glowing gradient orb drifts inside the button and swells to chase the pointer on hover.

items.name: otp-reels
items.title: OTP Reels
items.description: A one-time code input where each digit spins in like a slot reel, shakes on a wrong code and glows on success.

items.name: outline-fill
items.title: Outline Fill
items.description: Outlined lettering that draws its stroke, then wipes in a solid fill on view or on hover.

items.name: page-transition
items.title: Page Transition
items.description: A staggered, layered column curtain that covers the old view, swaps content, then sweeps away to reveal the new one.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page controls with fixed-width ellipsis logic, a spring-sliding active pill, and ellipses that turn into skip buttons on hover.

items.name: panel-glide
items.title: Panel Glide
items.description: A row of image panels where the hovered or focused one glides open with its caption while the rest compress.

items.name: panorama-sphere
items.title: Panorama Sphere
items.description: Photos tiled across the inside of a sphere that you drag to look around, with inertia and click-to-enlarge.

items.name: parallax-cards
items.title: Parallax Cards
items.description: A draggable, snapping row of photo cards whose images drift inside their frames as the row scrolls and tilt toward the pointer.

items.name: parallax-strings
items.title: Parallax Strings
items.description: Three depth layers of thin glowing wave lines drifting with parallax and parting around the cursor.

items.name: pastel-curtains
items.title: Pastel Curtains
items.description: Gentle pastel aurora curtains that sway in slow vertical folds, with soft light rays. WebGL.

items.name: peekaboo-stars
items.title: Peekaboo Stars
items.description: Star rating with a little character that peeks over the card, rising and grinning wider the higher you hover. Arrow keys, Home/End and digits work too.

items.name: peel-decal
items.title: Peel Decal
items.description: A glossy sticker whose corner curls back on hover and follows your drag, showing its paper back and a soft lifted shadow.

items.name: phosphor-wall
items.title: Phosphor Wall
items.description: A scrolling wall of phosphor glyphs on a worn CRT, with scanlines, flicker, torn glitch bands and color fringing. WebGL.

items.name: photo-fan
items.title: Photo Fan
items.description: A fanned stack of photo cards that bounce into place when scrolled into view and spread apart on hover.

items.name: photo-wake
items.title: Photo Wake
items.description: Photos pop in along the cursor path, then drift, shrink and fade away.

items.name: pin-matrix
items.title: Pin Matrix
items.description: A calm dot matrix that lights up around the cursor. Redraws only on movement.

items.name: pin-pile
items.title: Pin Pile
items.description: Cards pin to the top of a scroll container and pile onto each other, with covered cards shrinking and dimming underneath.

items.name: pixel-background
items.title: Pixel Background
items.description: A coarse pixel mosaic whose tiles drift through a palette in slow waves and light up around the cursor. Canvas 2D.

items.name: pixel-highlight
items.title: Pixel Highlight
items.description: Hovering or focusing fills the element with twinkling pixels that ripple out from the pointer, and ripple away on leave.

items.name: pixel-shock
items.title: Pixel Shock
items.description: A dithered field of tiny pixels that breathes with noise and bursts into shockwave rings on click. WebGL.

items.name: pop-check
items.title: Pop Check
items.description: Checkbox that squashes on press, pops and wobbles when checked, floods with color from the center and springs its tick in with a spark burst.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored popover on the native Popover API: top-layer, light dismiss and Escape for free, smart flipping, an arrow and a spring scale-in from the trigger.

items.name: poster-stream
items.title: Poster Stream
items.description: Posters fly through 3D space in a curving vertical stream you steer by scrolling or dragging inside the container.

items.name: print-dots
items.title: Print Dots
items.description: Renders an image as breathing halftone dots that swell and melt into the full photo around the cursor.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Linear and circular progress with a spring-animated value and counting label, a moving sheen, and indeterminate slide and spin states.

items.name: pull-hover
items.title: Pull Hover
items.description: Pulls its children toward the cursor when it gets close.

items.name: radial-flow
items.title: Radial Flow
items.description: A hub-and-spoke diagram where glowing data pulses stream along curved links between a central node and its connected services.

items.name: radial-socials
items.title: Radial Socials
items.description: A share button that fans social links out along a radial arc with a staggered spring, a drawn guide arc and brand-colored hovers.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Native radio group restyled with a springy dot and ripple, plus a card variant whose selection outline slides between options. Arrow keys just work.

items.name: read-focus
items.title: Read Focus
items.description: A paragraph whose words sharpen from dim and blurred to crisp as it scrolls through view.

items.name: reasoning-trace
items.title: Reasoning Trace
items.description: An AI reasoning indicator: the label ripples letter by letter, the current step shimmers past, and a click unfolds the full trace of steps.

items.name: reel
items.title: Reel
items.description: A vertical short-video reel that snaps clip to clip on scroll or drag, with story-style progress bars, slow Ken Burns motion, hold-to-pause and double-tap likes.

items.name: refract-panel
items.title: Refract Panel
items.description: A liquid-glass panel whose rim bends the backdrop through an SVG displacement map, with chromatic fringes, blur and a specular edge.

items.name: reveal-text
items.title: Reveal Text
items.description: Letters rise out of a mask as they scroll into view; hover and a photo shows through the type.

items.name: ring-pill
items.title: Ring Pill
items.description: An incoming-call pill with pulsing rings that expands into accept and decline, then morphs into a live call timer.

items.name: ring-switch
items.title: Ring Switch
items.description: A notification switch whose bell swings and rings when enabled, and gets a drawn slash when muted.

items.name: ring-tunnel
items.title: Ring Tunnel
items.description: An endless flight through a bending tunnel of glowing rings and spark-lit lines. WebGL.

items.name: ring-type
items.title: Ring Type
items.description: Text wrapped around a slowly spinning ring that speeds up, slows down or stops when hovered, with optional content in the middle.

items.name: rip-stub
items.title: Rip Stub
items.description: An event ticket whose perforated stub you pull against rubber-band tension until it rips free and tumbles away, stamping a confirmation onto the ticket.

items.name: rise-chars
items.title: Rise Chars
items.description: Characters stretch, rise and fade into place one after another, scrubbed by scroll position inside any scroll container.

items.name: rope-curtain
items.title: Rope Curtain
items.description: A curtain of hanging verlet ropes that sway in a soft breeze and part around the cursor.

items.name: row-slide
items.title: Row Slide
items.description: Tilted rows of tiles that slide in alternating directions as the cursor moves across.

items.name: rubber-range
items.title: Rubber Range
items.description: Range slider whose track stretches like rubber when dragged past either end, then springs back. Keyboard accessible.

items.name: ruler-input
items.title: Ruler Input
items.description: Design-tool number field: drag sideways to scrub the value over a sliding tick ruler, Shift for coarse, Alt for fine, and it stretches like rubber at the limits. Click to type, arrows to step.

items.name: satin-folds
items.title: Satin Folds
items.description: Flowing silk fabric with soft folds, a satin sheen and fine film grain. WebGL.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Native scrolling with slim overlay scrollbars that fade in on hover or scroll, draggable thumbs and soft fading edges where there is more to see.

items.name: search-cell
items.title: Search Cell
items.description: A command-style search field that widens on focus and unfolds grouped, ranked results with highlighted matches, a sliding selection and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Custom listbox select in the native top layer: grouped options with icons, a gliding highlight, drawn check marks, typeahead, full keyboard support and a real form value.

items.name: sensitive-text
items.title: Sensitive Text
items.description: Spoiler text veiled by blur and shimmering noise particles until you hover, focus or click it.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider with an optional centered label, a primary gradient variant and a draw-in animation that grows outward from the label.

items.name: sheen-card
items.title: Sheen Card
items.description: Polished metal or glass card whose streaks, specular band and hotspot slide across the surface as the pointer tilts it.

items.name: sheen-type
items.title: Sheen Type
items.description: A soft highlight sweeps across the text on a loop.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Side panel on the native <dialog> that slides in from any edge with a springy ease, staggers its content in, blurs the backdrop and returns focus on close.

items.name: shiny-button
items.title: Shiny Button
items.description: Gradient border and inner glow that follow the cursor.

items.name: shuffle-text
items.title: Shuffle Text
items.description: Each letter spins like a slot-machine reel and lands on its final character, on view and on hover.

items.name: shy-button
items.title: Shy Button
items.description: A playful yes/no prompt whose No button springs away from the cursor, leaning into each hop, until it gets tired. Keyboard users can always press it.

items.name: signal-glitch
items.title: Signal Glitch
items.description: RGB-split slices jitter across the text like a broken signal.

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Signup Form
items.description: A sign-up card with a live, animated password-strength meter and rule checklist, terms consent, inline validation and a celebratory success state.

items.name: slat-light
items.title: Slat Light
items.description: Venetian-blind strips refracting a drifting gradient, lit by a spotlight that follows the cursor.

items.name: slide-text
items.title: Slide Text
items.description: On hover every letter rolls out of view and a fresh copy slides in behind it, in a staggered wave.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or range slider with springy thumbs, a value bubble, tick marks with labels, glide-to-click and full keyboard support (arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End).

items.name: slingshot
items.title: Slingshot
items.description: Pull the button back on rubber bands and let go: past the threshold it fires and whips home with overshoot. A normal click works too.

items.name: smoke-column
items.title: Smoke Column
items.description: A tall column of light filled with slowly swirling volumetric smoke. WebGL.

items.name: snap-crop
items.title: Snap Crop
items.description: Crop frame with springy corner handles that magnetically snap to edges, thirds and center, with snap guides and a live pixel-size readout.

items.name: snap-slides
items.title: Snap Slides
items.description: A draggable, snapping carousel whose off-center slides tilt away in 3D, with dots, autoplay and arrow-key support.

items.name: social-orbit
items.title: Social Orbit
items.description: An avatar with social links circling it on two counter-rotating rings, upright icons, brand-colored hovers and tooltip labels; pauses on hover.

items.name: spark-waves
items.title: Spark Waves
items.description: Glowing sine waves braid across the stage and shed drifting sparks from their crests. Canvas 2D.

items.name: spectrum-burst
items.title: Spectrum Burst
items.description: A radial burst of light rays pulsing outward from the center, split into rainbow fringes by chromatic dispersion. WebGL.

items.name: spike-blob
items.title: Spike Blob
items.description: A glossy black ferrofluid blob whose spikes rise toward the cursor like it is chasing a magnet.

items.name: spiral-stars
items.title: Spiral Stars
items.description: A slowly spinning spiral galaxy of twinkling stars and glowing dust, with depth parallax under the cursor.

items.name: splitter
items.title: Splitter
items.description: Resizable split panes with a draggable handle, min/max limits, and full keyboard resizing.

items.name: sprout-menu
items.title: Sprout Menu
items.description: A trigger that grows curved branches out to its sub-actions, then pulls them back in when it closes.

items.name: squares-grid
items.title: Squares Grid
items.description: An endlessly scrolling grid; the square under the cursor fills in.

items.name: squash-toggle
items.title: Squash Toggle
items.description: Toggle switch whose thumb widens in anticipation while pressed, stretches and flattens as it travels, then bounces into place.

items.name: stagger-button
items.title: Stagger Button
items.description: Each letter of the label rolls upward one after another on hover.

items.name: stagger-chars
items.title: Stagger Chars
items.description: Hover and a wave of bouncing, tilting characters ripples through the text with a flash of accent color.

items.name: state-icon
items.title: State Icon
items.description: One status icon that morphs between idle dot, spinning arc, a ring that closes into a popping check, and a shaking cross.

items.name: static-type
items.title: Static Type
items.description: Canvas-drawn lettering whose pixel rows jitter sideways like a weak signal, getting noisier when you hover it.

items.name: stats-carousel
items.title: Stats Carousel
items.description: A carousel of KPI cards whose numbers count up and sparklines draw in as each one slides to center.

items.name: stats-count
items.title: Stats Count
items.description: A row of big statistics that count up with a staggered reveal when scrolled into view.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: Presence indicator (online, away, busy, offline): a colored dot with rippling rings, an optional tinted pill and a soft crossfade when the status changes.

items.name: step-flow
items.title: Step Flow
items.description: Multi-step flow with a filling progress track, pulsing active step, sliding content that resizes smoothly and a completion state.

items.name: streak-rain
items.title: Streak Rain
items.description: Streaks of light falling like rain across three depth layers, each with a glowing head and fading trail. WebGL.

items.name: streamers
items.title: Streamers
items.description: Silky, twisting ribbons that chase the cursor on springs and fan out as they lag behind.

items.name: stretch-rail
items.title: Stretch Rail
items.description: Sidebar navigation whose glowing line indicator stretches toward the new item and springs back to size.

items.name: stretch-tabs
items.title: Stretch Tabs
items.description: Segmented control whose pill indicator stretches like rubber toward the new option, thins out as it pulls, then snaps shut.

items.name: strip-delete
items.title: Strip Delete
items.description: Delete a document card and it feeds into a rattling shredder, coming out as strips that scatter and fall, with an undo that drops it back in.

items.name: strip-gradient
items.title: Strip Gradient
items.description: A flowing wave gradient cut into horizontal strips that glide sideways independently. WebGL.

items.name: stripe-button
items.title: Stripe Button
items.description: Diagonal barber stripes that brighten and scroll on hover, like a live progress bar.

items.name: striped-grid
items.title: Striped Grid
items.description: A slowly scrolling grid of diagonally hatched cells that light up and fade as the cursor passes. Canvas 2D.

items.name: surge-marquee
items.title: Surge Marquee
items.description: Rows of oversized marquee text that drift on their own and surge or reverse with scroll speed.

items.name: swarm-word
items.title: Swarm Word
items.description: Thousands of tiny particles swarm together to spell a word, burst away from the cursor and spring back into place.

items.name: sweep-line
items.title: Sweep Line
items.description: A bright scan line sweeping back and forth over a faint dot grid, leaving a fading afterglow. WebGL.

items.name: sweep-menu
items.title: Sweep Menu
items.description: Menu button that sweeps staggered colored layers across the screen before a panel of oversized links rises into place.

items.name: sweep-scope
items.title: Sweep Scope
items.description: A phosphor radar scope: a rotating sweep with a fading trail, range rings, bearing ticks and contacts that ping as the beam passes. WebGL.

items.name: swipe-action
items.title: Swipe Action
items.description: List row you swipe right to archive or left to delete, with rubber-band resistance, an armed pop past the threshold and a collapse on commit. Arrow keys + Enter work too.

items.name: swipe-stack
items.title: Swipe Stack
items.description: A deck of cards you drag away to reveal the next one. Keyboard accessible.

items.name: swirl
items.title: Swirl
items.description: A psychedelic paint swirl in two bold colors outlined with ink, with an optional chunky-pixel mode. WebGL.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Data table with sortable headers (flipping chevron arrows), rows that glide into their new order, hover and selection states with animated checkboxes and a sticky blurred header.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Accessible tabs with a spring-animated pill or underline indicator, roving arrow-key focus, direction-aware panel transitions and lazily mounted panels that keep their state.

items.name: tail-knob
items.title: Tail Knob
items.description: A drag-around knob whose indicator trails a glowing comet tail, with a live readout and full arrow-key support.

items.name: tally
items.title: Tally
items.description: Animates a number from one value to another when it enters the viewport.

items.name: tank-gauge
items.title: Tank Gauge
items.description: Round liquid gauge whose level springs to each new value and sloshes side to side before settling, with the readout inverting where the liquid covers it. Drag or key it to set the level.

items.name: tap-burst
items.title: Tap Burst
items.description: Bursts of sparks radiate from every click inside the area.

items.name: tap-flip
items.title: Tap Flip
items.description: A small flash card that lifts off the table and springs over toward the side you tap, with a shadow that shrinks mid-turn. Enter or Space flips it too.

items.name: task-widget
items.title: Task Widget
items.description: An iOS-like glass widget with a live clock, weather line and tactile task cards that frost toward the tail of the list.

items.name: testimonial-carousel
items.title: Testimonial Carousel
items.description: One testimonial at a time with avatar, star rating and quote. Swipe, arrows, dots, and auto-play that pauses on hover.

items.name: text-generate
items.title: Text Generate
items.description: Words stream in one by one out of a soft blur, like a model typing its answer, with an optional glowing caret.

items.name: text-highlighter
items.title: Text Highlighter
items.description: A marker-pen stroke swipes behind chosen words as they scroll into view, flipping the ink color in sync.

items.name: text-modifier
items.title: Text Modifier
items.description: Hand-drawn pen annotations (circles, underlines, boxes, strikes and crosses) that sketch themselves around words.

items.name: text-spotlight
items.title: Text Spotlight
items.description: Dimmed text with a soft, gradient-lit spotlight that trails your cursor and drifts on its own when idle.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: A day/night switch: the sun rolls across, its rays retract as a shadow bites it into a crescent, clouds drift off and stars burst out and twinkle.

items.name: thunder-loader
items.title: Thunder Loader
items.description: A lightning bolt that charges up in stuttering surges while arcs crackle around it, then flashes white, throws sparks and discharges. Pass progress for a determinate meter.

items.name: tide-lines
items.title: Tide Lines
items.description: Stacked lines flowing like a noise-driven sea; the cursor drags through them and they spring back.

items.name: tile-smear
items.title: Tile Smear
items.description: An image on a grid of tiles that smear along with the cursor and ease back into place.

items.name: tilt-blocks
items.title: Tilt Blocks
items.description: A field of 3D cubes that tilt toward the cursor and flip in a glowing ripple when clicked.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: 3D perspective tilt that follows the pointer, with an optional glare.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Vertical timeline whose glowing progress line fills as you scroll, lighting up markers and revealing entries.

items.name: tint-type
items.title: Tint Type
items.description: Text filled with a slowly flowing multi-stop gradient.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast system (provider + useToast hook) with variants, actions, in-place updates, a collapsed stack that fans out on hover, swipe to dismiss and a pausable countdown bar.

items.name: toggle-vault
items.title: Toggle Vault
items.description: A lock switch styled as a vault door: the combination dial winds back, spins, and the bolts retract; locking spins it home and slams the bolts shut.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hover and focus tooltip in the native top layer: open delay with instant hand-off between neighbors, auto-flip placement, a tracking arrow and a springy fade-scale.

items.name: torch-card
items.title: Torch Card
items.description: A soft light follows the cursor across the card surface.

items.name: trail-range
items.title: Trail Range
items.description: A range slider whose thumb drags a glowing wake behind it and squashes when flicked fast. Built on a native range input, so keyboard and forms just work.

items.name: twine
items.title: Twine
items.description: A bundle of thin glowing threads twisting like strings in the wind, bending toward the cursor.

items.name: twinkle-card
items.title: Twinkle Card
items.description: A card whose background ripples into a field of twinkling canvas pixels on hover or focus, with built-in color themes.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types and deletes a list of phrases with a blinking cursor.

items.name: unblur-heading
items.title: Unblur Heading
items.description: Words or letters drift in from above or below, sharpening out of a heavy blur as they scroll into view.

items.name: updraft-dust
items.title: Updraft Dust
items.description: Weightless glowing dust that drifts upward and curls away from the cursor.

items.name: venom-beam
items.title: Venom Beam
items.description: A dark beam of oily, noise-driven tendrils writhing over a toxic green glow, shedding venom droplets. WebGL.

items.name: vercel-card
items.title: Vercel Card
items.description: Minimal monochrome card with a fading grid, corner plus markers and a pointer spotlight that lights up the grid lines.

items.name: warp-highway
items.title: Warp Highway
items.description: A night highway of light trails rushing toward you. Hold the pointer down to punch it into warp.

items.name: watcher-iris
items.title: Watcher Iris
items.description: A giant smoldering eye with a churning iris and slit pupil that tracks the cursor and blinks now and then. WebGL.

items.name: water-image
items.title: Water Image
items.description: An image that ripples like a water surface wherever the cursor passes, with a hint of chromatic split. WebGL.

items.name: wave-mesh
items.title: Wave Mesh
items.description: Glowing grid lines bent by ripples spreading from the center and from the cursor. WebGL.

items.name: wavy-button
items.title: Wavy Button
items.description: Liquid sloshes at the bottom and rises in a rolling SVG wave to fill the button on hover.

items.name: weave-lines
items.title: Weave Lines
items.description: Dozens of fine horizontal lines weaving into flowing silk-like waves that bulge away from the cursor. Canvas 2D.

items.name: weight-press
items.title: Weight Press
items.description: A full-width headline whose letters swell in weight and stretch taller as the cursor presses close.

items.name: white-stripes
items.title: White Stripes
items.description: Layers of satin-shaded diagonal stripes drift at different speeds, casting soft shadows with cursor parallax. WebGL.

items.name: wipe-menu
items.title: Wipe Menu
items.description: Full-width menu rows; hovering one wipes in a marquee of text and images from the edge you entered.

items.name: wisp-fibers
items.title: Wisp Fibers
items.description: Translucent glowing fibers that braid, drift apart and fade in and out like ghostly silk.

items.name: word-cycle
items.title: Word Cycle
items.description: Cycles through a list of words with a vertical slide.

items.name: word-pile
items.title: Word Pile
items.description: A paragraph whose words tumble down and pile up with real physics on hover, click or view, then can be grabbed and tossed around.
